sales.title:
1869 Pattern Cent. Judd-666, Pollock-742. Rarity-5. Nickel. Plain Edge. Proof-65 (PCGS). CAC.
Obv: Obverse 2. Bust of Liberty faces left with the legend UNITED STATES OF AMERICA around the border and the date 1869 below. Liberty is wearing a coronet inscribed LIBERTY, the design similar to that used for regular issue nickel three-cent piece production from 1865 through 1889. The digit 9 is under the left side of the lowest curl and is closer to the denticles. Rev: Reverse A. A laurel wreath surrounds a Roman numeral I, the ribbon ends broad. Pretty bright silver gray surfaces are boldly struck and reflective.
From Heritage's sale of the Eric P. Newman Collection, Part I, April 2013 CSNS Signature Auction, lot 3967, as NGC Proof-66; Heritage's CSNS Signature Auction of April 2018, lot 4993, as NGC Proof-66.
PCGS# 60890. NGC ID: 29PM.
PCGS Population: 10; 2 finer in this category (Proof-66 finest).

CAC Stickered Population: 3; 0.
